page.layout: One printed page with a single text column, plus an empty narrow column at the left (no text, only a blot). The right edge of the neighbouring printed page is cut off at the right of the scan and is not transcribed. Full-width heading and running head at top; text column below it, then the greeting and signature centred.

l.i: Faxit Æternum numen, ut spei de te con-
cepta, & votis publicis, res ipsa respondeat,
quod euenturum facile sperem, si illud in
oculo, in aure, in animo semper geras:
Et Pater Æneas, & avunculus excitet Hector.

page.notes: The "Celsitudinis" line and the signature are centred. The epigraph is set in italic; the second line may have a different type style, but it is transcribed as italic. The stain at the left margin and the faint show-through on the page are not transcribed. The right page on the scan is only a cropped edge of the neighbouring page (a woodcut border and the start of a title, "In..."), so it is not transcribed.
